title: passage-recall shadow metric (peer-comparability instrument)

neo4j_identity_verification.reingest_note: live graph carries 7575 entities vs the frozen r47 cache's 6,626 - a RE-INGEST superset of the same medium slice; node IDs mostly align (see retrieved_union_id_match). Seeds/recall come from the frozen cache; the provenance projection uses the live graph, joined on entity id.

retrieved_union_id_match.note: nodes absent from the live re-ingest contribute NO passages -> the shadow recall below is a CONSERVATIVE lower bound

schema.passage_unit: Chunk (== one 2wiki article; chunk.text first line == article title; PASSAGE granularity)

def16_state: KGFPassage label ABSENT (0 nodes) - confirmed. The Chunk label plays the passage role: Entity-[:MENTIONED_IN]->Chunk, chunk.text first line == 2wiki article title. Provenance IS present and sufficient; no DEF-16 repair blocks the instrument.

provenance_coverage_carrier_nodes.definition: carrier node has >=1 Entity-[:MENTIONED_IN]->Chunk provenance edge

shadow_metric_peer_form.granularity: PASSAGE (Chunk == one 2wiki article) - directly comparable to HippoRAG passage-recall. NOT document-row granularity.
shadow_metric_peer_form.gold_passage_definition: chunks whose first-line title matches a gold supporting_fact title; all gold titles map to exactly one chunk, no collisions
shadow_metric_peer_form.retrieved_passage_rule: each retrieved node projected to its MENTIONED_IN chunks; passage score = max mentioning-node score; ranked high->low, deduped

shadow_metric_FLOOR_name_identity_prior_.note: the earlier BLOCKED run (Neo4j down) reported a provenance-free name-identity FLOOR: dense any@5/10/20 = 0.8939, rru = 0.9394. It credited only title-entity nodes. The peer-form metric above uses real MENTIONED_IN provenance and is the deliverable; the floor is kept only as the delta baseline.

definition.carrier_join_pass: ALL gold carrier titles present as nodes inside dense@16 (strict family join)
definition.shadow_pass: ANY gold passage (chunk) in top-16 retrieved passages (MENTIONED_IN projection)

correlation_2x2_shadow_vs_join.reading: join_fail/shadow_pass counts how much harsher the carrier-join is than peer passage-recall; join_pass/shadow_fail counts mapping loss (a joined carrier whose passage fell outside top-k)

peer_form_headline.caveat_block: GRANULARITY: this is PASSAGE-recall (Chunk == one 2wiki article), the same unit HippoRAG reports - side-by-side comparable. CAVEATS: (1) probe-level ANY-gold-in-top-k; report alongside ALL-golds and mean-fraction in the arms; (2) retrieved passages are a graph projection (node -> its MENTIONED_IN chunks), more generous than direct passage retrieval; (3) ~11% of retrieved nodes are absent from the live re-ingest and contribute no passages, so these figures are a conservative lower bound; (4) the carrier-join headline (0.6012, per-carrier-row) and the shadow (per-probe, passage) are DIFFERENT units - never blend them.

verdict_reason: carrier node->chunk provenance covers 97.2% of cache carriers (100.0% of those present in the re-ingest); peer-form passage-recall ships beside the join with the 2x2 stated
